text: The authors state that the user's decomposition of task evaluation into simpler assistance tasks must be exhaustive, because any neglected aspect of the outcome may be optimised by the new agent in an arbitrary, undesirable direction. They suggest having agent A2 propose a decomposition and agent A1 critique it by pointing out omitted aspects.
title: Evaluation decomposition must be exhaustive, possibly checked by an agent critique
